title: The Overpass and the Altar Stone
core_theme: The displacement of localized divinity by modern infrastructure.
narrative_spec: Set the scene at a highway construction site where an ancient, unnamed protective deity of a grove is unmade by a hydraulic excavator.

title: The Sovereignty of the Empty Feast Hall
core_theme: The psychological decay of victory in an unpeopled kingdom.
narrative_spec: A victorious king sits alone at a massive timber table after a century-long war that successfully defended Her borders but slaughtered her entire population. Can you enter Her mind?

title: The Iron Vanguard’s Slipped Gear
core_theme: The post-heroic obsolescence of an industrial golem.
narrative_spec: Examine a personal artifact of joy that is rooted in fantasy. describe its affect.

title: The Liturgy of the Deep-Sea Anchor
core_theme: The permanent exile of an ancient ocean titan.
narrative_spec: Trace the thoughts of a leviathan or sea deity that has chosen to pin itself to the absolute bottom of a dark tectonic trench to escape the sound of modern container ship propellers and sonar testing.

title: The Architecture of the Faded Map-Line
core_theme: The loss of mythical geography to secular surveying.
narrative_spec: Seek to describe a technology as if it is magic.

title: The Epistemology of the Keeper’s Last Oil
core_theme: The mechanical failure of a mythical lighthouse.
narrative_spec: Can you work against the grain and craft a poem that engages no emotion at all?

title: The Sinking Index of the Oracle’s Well
core_theme: The drying up of prophetic vision due to ecological strain.
narrative_spec: Create an industrial fantasy... I give you no further direction than that

title: The Foundation of the Closed Sky-Gate
core_theme: The total severing of mortal communication with the stars.

title: The Dialectics of the Centaur’s Shoeing
core_theme: The tragic compromise of mythic physiology for modern utility.
narrative_spec: A legendary half-human beast must allow a village blacksmith to nail rough, iron horseshoes into its hooves to navigate the paved roads of an encroaching empire. this one is weird... I know.

title: The Protocol of the Royal Scribe’s Hand
core_theme: The bureaucratic recording of an dynasty's final breath.
narrative_spec: An aging court historian sits in a freezing study, writing the final line of a thousand-year chronicle while barbarian forces break through the outer courtyard gates. Can you capture that level of depair? or pride?

title: The Litany of the Feral Valkyrie
core_theme: The survival of a war spirit without an empire.
narrative_spec: Imagine now you are a god like being of seduciton. Where might your worshipers be?  Write a narrative from that perspective.

title: The Sovereign Hearth of the Forest Hearth-God
core_theme: The starvation of domestic spirits after an exodus.
narrative_spec: Set the poem within the hollow trunk of a burnt cedar where a small, localized deity of hospitality starves because the village it protected was cleared for an open-pit coal mine. Treat the god’s dwindling light as a dying ember in wet tinder, gasping for the smoke of a human kitchen fire that will never return.

title: The Metric of the Unclaimed Crown Melt
core_theme: The reduction of sovereign mythos to standard bullion.
narrative_spec: A barbarian blacksmith melts down a historic, sacred crown of a conquered saint-king to mint common currency for a trade market. OHHH how history MOVES us

title: The Sovereignty of the Fading Loom
core_theme: The exhaustion of the fates spinning an unraveled destiny.

title: The Foundation of the Broken Sphinx
core_theme: The isolation of an riddle-giver whose audience has grown illiterate.
narrative_spec: Let your mind run WILD, absolutely FERAL keep going and going and going and stop when you think of something that is boring.

title: The Geometry of the Sun-God’s Eclipse
core_theme: The permanent withdrawal of solar favor from a ungrateful soil.
narrative_spec: Capture the precise moment a solar deity decides never to return its full heat to a country that has blacked out its horizon with coal smoke and industrial dust. but reverse this idea into something so simple and stupid its silly.
